description: Find where something is set up in the web interface: pages of the menu and system settings, each with the way through the menu and a link. Only pages the user may open are found. Use it for "where do I set up the mail server" or "where are the proxy settings".

limit.description: How many pages and how many settings to return at most.

query.description: Keywords for what the user looks for, in German and English, e.g. 'mail smtp absender sender'.

name: find_setting
title: Find a Setting
